en: Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a rural road leading into a small town. In the distance stands a prominent church with a large dome-like roof and tower, surrounded by modest houses and trees. Open fields border the road in the foreground. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom left and right, including the town name and photographer information.
